# Philadelphus inodorus L.

First published in Sp. Pl.: 470 (1753)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is West Virginia to SE. U.S.A. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

# Anacamptis fragrans (Pollini) R.M.Bateman

First published in Bot. J. Linn. Soc. 142: 12 (2003)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is Medit. to Iran. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
